C1198.title: Unauthorized AI-Generated Celebrity Impersonation in Livestream Sales Disrupts Online Order, Leads to Administrative Penalty
C1198.summary: The cybersecurity division in Datong, Shanxi, discovered that a local resident, Xing, used AI tools without authorization to create a digital persona resembling Cheng Li-wen, chairperson of the Kuomintang, for livestream sales. The act sparked public skepticism and severely disrupted normal online order. Xing was administratively penalized by public security authorities for fraudulently using anot

references.title: Shanxi Public Security Authorities Disclose Five Typical Cases of AI-Generated Rumors
